program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Collect all solid rectangles (of any non-zero color)
         (rects
          (for*/list ((r1 (range 0 h))
                      (c1 (range 0 w))
                      (r2 (range r1 h))
                      (c2 (range c1 w))
                      #:when (let ((clr (cell-at g r1 c1)))
                               (and (not (= clr 0))
                                    (for*/and ((rr (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
                                               (cc (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                      (= (cell-at g rr cc) clr)))))
            (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                  (cell-at g r1 c1) r1 c1 r2 c2)))
         (sorted (sort rects (lambda (a b) (> (first a) (first b)))))
         (best (first sorted))
         (clr (second best))
         (br1 (third best))
         (bc1 (fourth best))
         (br2 (list-ref best 4))
         (bc2 (list-ref best 5)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (cond
          ((and (>= r br1) (<= r br2) (>= c bc1) (<= c bc2)) 2)
          (else 0)))))))
